test2SkyZemaToolWallet.finding: A completed Zema Tool job does not automatically create a Wallet receipt. The Web Wallet currently uses manual book records, while verified earning receipts enter through the separate Sky Billing provider endpoint.

androidInstrumentation.environment: Android 15 API 35 arm64 Pixel 10 device-profile emulator
androidInstrumentation.testSigner: debug-only shared signer; not a release credential

androidBuildAndLint.scope: Platform Core, Tool SDK, automation APK and article Tool APK; standalone Gradle only, not Soong or an OS image

coverage: verified earnings settlement and Wallet connection

defectsFoundAndFixed: overlay application could silently target an unrelated parent Git repository
AIDL generation was disabled in the upstream Android app
public Android SDK builds used hidden UserHandle methods
the release manifest removed WAKE_LOCK required by Headless JS
